data.long_meaning: The name Jesús is derived from the Latin word Iesus, which is the Greek form of the Hebrew name Yeshua. In the New Testament of the Bible, Jesús is the name of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, who is believed to have been sent to save humanity from sin. The name Jesús carries the meaning “Savior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jesús usually hope their child will grow to embody savior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
